name: Half-elf Skald (CR 2)
body:
HALF-ELF SKALD
CR 2

XP 600
Male half-elf skald 3
CN Medium humanoid (elf, human)
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 10, touch 10, flat-footed 10
hp 20 (3d8+3)
Fort +4, Ref +1, Will +3; +2 vs. enchantments, +4 vs. bardic performance, language-dependent, and sonic
Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft.
Melee heavy mace +4 (1d8+1) or dagger +3 (1d4+1/19–20)
Ranged dagger +2 (1d4+1/19–20)
Special Attacks rage power (roaring drunk), raging song 18 rounds/day (inspired rage, song of marching)
Skald Spells Known (CL 3rd; concentration +5)

1st (4/day)—beguiling gift (DC 13), charm person (DC 13), comprehend languages, hideous laughter (DC 13)
0th (at will)—detect magic, know direction, mending, prestidigitation, sift, summon instrument

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 10, Con 13, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 15
Base Atk +2; CMB +3; CMD 13 (9 vs. trip)
Feats Extra Performance, Lingering Performance, Scribe Scroll, Skill Focus (Perform [sing])
Skills Craft (musical instruments) +6, Diplomacy +8, Perception +8, Perform (percussion) +8, Perform (sing) +11, Profession (innkeeper) +6; Racial Modifiers +2 Perception
Languages Aquan, Common, Elven, Polyglot
SQ bardic knowledge +1, elf blood, one-legged, versatile performance (sing)
Combat Gear potion of cure light wounds, potion of mage armor, wand of create treasure map (5 charges); Other Gear dagger, heavy mace, 143 gp

SPECIAL ABILITIES

One-Legged (Ex)

NPC has only one leg, which reduces his speed by half and means he cannot charge.
